surface: Global side-panel notices over Capture, Scrape, Settings and Vault
auth_mode: signed-in member selecting an organization on this device
reproduction: Open the side panel before selecting an organization. The Capture list read raises a no-workspace refusal and NoticeHost renders a fixed bottom notice.
Select an existing organization in Settings. Capture refreshes, but the original no-workspace notice persists until manually dismissed.
On a 360 by 421 panel, the stale notice overlaps the enabled Scrape Save button. The trusted pointer driver finds zero hit-tested points within that button.
expected: A no-workspace read notice retires when selecting an organization completes its prerequisite, including a delayed read refusal. A failed insert or update remains visible because choosing an organization does not replay that write. Unrelated refusals remain visible.
actual: Before the operation-aware correction, selecting an organization retired both resolved no-workspace read notices and unperformed write notices. On the corrected release 0.2.79, the read notice retired after organization selection while the same visible failed highlight-write notice remained; the write had not been sent and was not replayed.
severity: S2: a resolved read notice can obstruct controls; an unperformed write notice can disappear after workspace selection, leaving an unsaved highlight or undeleted capture without its failure announcement
priority: P1: make notice retirement depend on whether the operation's remedy is actually complete; keep unperformed write failures visible until a real retry or explicit dismissal
